display.purpose: Page titles only. One per screen.

body.purpose: Table cells, detail values, running text.

shadows.name: dialog

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button. Orange fill, white text, 32px height.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: #F97316; color: #fff; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #EA580C; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #F97316; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.5); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary/cancel action. Transparent at rest, muted fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: transparent; color: #111827; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #F9FAFB; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #F97316; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.5); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Dangerous actions. Tinted red background, never solid fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.1); color: #DC2626; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.2); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.2); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Semantic status pill used across orders, inventory, and payments.
components.css: .ds-badge-open, .ds-badge-completed, .ds-badge-cancelled, .ds-badge-shipped { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 10px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: capitalize; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid; } .ds-badge-open { background: #EFF6FF; color: #1D4ED8; border-color: #BFDBFE; } .ds-badge-completed { background: #F0FDF4; color: #15803D; border-color: #BBF7D0; } .ds-badge-cancelled { background: #FEF2F2; color: #DC2626; border-color: #FECACA; } .ds-badge-shipped { background: #FFFBEB; color: #B45309; border-color: #FDE68A; }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: Compact card with uppercase label and large number. The primary summary widget.
components.css: .ds-metric-card { overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; background: #fff; padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-metric-label { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #6B7280; margin: 0; } .ds-metric-value { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #111827; margin: 4px 0 0 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input. White bg, gray border, orange focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; width: 100%; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; background: #fff; padding: 0 12px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #111827; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B7280; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #F97316; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.3); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Dark sidebar navigation link. Zinc text at rest, white on hover/active.
components.html: StockSalesProcurement
components.css: .ds-sidenav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 0 12px; background: #18181B; } .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #A1A1AA; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #fff; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); } .ds-nav-active { color: #fff; background: rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.1); font-weight: 500; }

components.description: Screen title bar with optional trailing actions.
components.html: Sales Orders
components.css: .ds-page-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-page-title { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: #111827; margin: 0; } .ds-page-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-page-header .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: #F97316; color: #fff; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-page-header .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #EA580C; }

narrative.overview:
Solext's visual system is built around the metaphor of a clean, focused control room: a dark navigation spine anchoring a bright, spacious operational workspace. Orange is the signal color — it draws the eye precisely where action is needed, from the brand mark in the sidebar to primary buttons and active states. The system pairs this operational precision with soft, approachable component shapes that keep the interface from feeling clinical, even when displaying dense data tables and inventory metrics.

The overall density is moderate. Screens breathe — metric cards sit in generous grid layouts, tables have comfortable row heights, and sections are clearly separated by muted surface bands. The interface is designed for extended use by warehouse and sales staff who live in it all day; nothing shouts, but the hierarchy is always clear.
keyCharacteristics: Dark sidebar, bright content area — high-contrast structural split
Orange as the singular accent and action color
Soft radii on all interactive elements (gently curved edges, 8px)
DM Sans throughout — humanist sans-serif with weight variation
Status communicated through tinted pill badges
AG Grid tables as the primary data surface

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange is the only chromatic accent in the primary UI. If you're reaching for a second accent color outside of status badges, stop — orange should be doing that job. Its scarcity is what makes it effective.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Face Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a second typeface. DM Sans at weights 400-800 covers every hierarchical need. If you need more contrast, adjust weight and case, not font family.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The only shadow in the entire system is on dialogs and dropdown menus. If a new component wants a shadow, it's probably trying to be a dialog.

dos: Do use orange exclusively as the action/accent color. Every interactive highlight, focus ring, and brand element is orange or transparent-orange.
Do use the tinted-surface formula for status badges: bg-{hue}-50 text-{hue}-700 border-{hue}-200.
Do use the text-title, text-header, text-subheader, text-body, text-body-muted, and text-large-number utility classes for typography.
Do wrap every AG Grid instance in a bordered card container (rounded-lg border border-border bg-card overflow-hidden).
Do use MetricCard + MetricCardRow for any numeric summary.
donts: Don't introduce shadows on cards or containers. The system is flat; depth comes from borders and tonal surfaces.
Don't use a second typeface. DM Sans at varying weights covers every need.
Don't use solid-fill destructive buttons. Destructive actions use tinted backgrounds (10-20% opacity) with colored text.
Don't use colored left borders as active-state indicators (the border-l-3 pattern is a detected anti-pattern).
Don't add icons to navigation items. The current system uses text-only nav.
